annotations.title: Flood risk for a Dutch address (paid)

description: Netherlands flood risk per address from Rijkswaterstaat's LIWO: annual probability that the location floods (any water, over 20, 50 and 200 cm), 2050 and 2100 climate scenarios, worst-case modelled water depth, and ground height vs sea level (AHN). Climate and physical risk data for real estate, mortgage, insurance, ESG and relocation agents. Input: postcode + house number. Costs $0.004 USDC via x402, or one unit of a Factline API key quota.

q.description: Alternative to postcode: free-text address, e.g. 'Visschersplein 1 Utrecht'
